subregion.name: Central Processional

subregion.name: Eastern Crypts

subregion.name: Hall of Pillars

subregion.name: High Gate Approach
subregion.summary: A fortified northern descent into the burial grounds flanked by solemn stone archways.

subregion.name: Northern Vaults
subregion.summary: Broad vaulted halls carved into cold bedrock to store the first tiers of the dead.

subregion.name: Sepulcher Cloisters

subregion.name: Sunken Charnel
subregion.summary: A low-lying expanse of cavernous mortuary halls and bone repositories.

subregion.name: Threshold of Bone
subregion.summary: The southeastern terminus of the necropolis complex leading out toward the lower ruins.

subregion.name: Upper Catacombs
subregion.summary: A dense network of tightly packed burial niches and stone tomb chambers in the northern quarter.

subregion.name: Western Columbarium
subregion.summary: Dusty niches and urn-lined passageways along the western periphery of the necropolis.

subregion.name: Whispering Galleries
subregion.summary: A complex of reverberating corridors and stone halls along the eastern boundary.
